title: What is NyxID?
body: NyxID manages sign-in and lets you connect services to an AI assistant through controlled credentials. You choose which accounts to connect and which access to allow. The public guide can explain NyxID and help you start linking your own account.

title: Using your personal NyxBot in Telegram
body: Linking connects this private Telegram chat to your own NyxBot. New personal messages can use the access, memory and credits already available to your NyxBot. Review the account and access on the NyxID website, then return to the same private chat and send the confirmation command shown there. A signup link alone does not authorize personal access.

title: What the public guide can do
body: The public guide answers questions from this approved help collection and can offer a link to review or create your own NyxID account. It cannot inspect accounts, connected services, files, messages, secrets or personal memory. Public guide costs use the configured sponsor budget; personal work uses your own account billing after you confirm linking.

title: Connecting services
body: After signing in to NyxID, use the account interface to connect the services you want your NyxBot to use. Review each connection and its access. The public guide cannot connect a service, select another account, grant access or perform work in a connected service for you.

title: Reviewing actions
body: Your personal NyxBot follows your account's access settings and may ask for confirmation before an action. Review the action in NyxID or use the exact confirmation command offered in the private Telegram chat. Never send passwords, API keys or one-time login codes to the public guide.

title: Disconnecting Telegram
body: Send /unlink in the private manager chat or revoke the Telegram link in your NyxID account. This stops new personal work from that link. Saved history remains in NyxID, and work started independently there may continue. Send /link in the private chat when you want to review linking again.

title: Opening a signup or linking link
body: A signup or linking link opens the NyxID website so you can sign in or create your own account and review the Telegram link. Treat the link as private. The website asks you to return to this same private chat for final confirmation. Opening a link or asking the public guide for one does not link an account.
